pr_title: Bluetooth: BAP: Add log of err in bt_bap_stream_detach
pr_body:
We can't really do anything about it if it fails, so we simply log the value.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/66820

review_comments:
I was considering that, but it is also called during stream-reset, in which case we may not have an ACL, and this would always fail in that case, and we wouldn't want to log it as an error in that case. 

The alternative to this logging would be to simply ignore the return value.
